Class Display

java.lang.Object
jwium.lab1.messageboard.view.Display
public class Display extends Object
Handles the presentation of information to the user. Displays messages, menu options, and other text in the console.

    • printAllMessages

      public void printAllMessages(MessagesManager manager)
      Prints all messages stored in the message manager. Each message is preceded by its position in the list, starting from 1.
      Parameters:
      manager - the manager containing the messages to display
